::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false}
## TL;DR

Two simulators. Lift an air parcel and watch the cloud base appear, then set up a whole cloud and watch droplets grow on their nuclei.
:::

Experiment with the physics of cloud formation using the interactive simulators below.

### Simulator 1: Thermodynamic Parcel Lifter & LCL Calculator

Adjust the surface temperature ($T_0$), dew point ($T_{d0}$), and the environmental lapse rate. Watch the air parcel ascend along the **Dry Adiabatic Lapse Rate (DALR)**, strike the **Lifting Condensation Level (LCL)**, and transition into moist cloud growth!

::: {.sim-card}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof t0 = Inputs.range([10, 40], {value: 26, step: 0.5, label: "Surface air temp T₀ (°C)"})
viewof td0 = Inputs.range([-5, 30], {value: 16, step: 0.5, label: "Surface dew point Td₀ (°C)"})
viewof elr = Inputs.range([4.0, 11.0], {value: 7.5, step: 0.2, label: "Environmental lapse rate (°C/km)"})

// A dew point above the air temperature is unphysical; the original clamped it.
td = Math.min(td0, t0)

dalr = 9.8   // dry adiabatic lapse rate, °C/km
malr = 5.5   // saturated (moist) adiabatic lapse rate, °C/km
maxAlt = 3500 // m

// Espy's rule: the parcel and dew point converge at ~8 °C/km apart.
zLCL = Math.max(0, 125 * (t0 - td))

// Magnus approximation for saturation vapour pressure, hPa.
esat = t => 6.112 * Math.exp((17.67 * t) / (t + 243.5))
rh = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (esat(td) / esat(t0)) * 100))

stability = elr > dalr
  ? {text: "Absolutely Unstable (Severe Convection)", colour: "#ef4444"}
  : elr < malr
  ? {text: "Absolutely Stable (Stratus / Fog)", colour: "#38bdf8"}
  : {text: "Conditionally Unstable (Cumulus / Showers)", colour: "#f59e0b"}

profiles = {
  const tLCL = t0 - dalr * (zLCL / 1000);
  const out = [];
  for (let z = 0; z <= maxAlt; z += 50) {
    out.push({z, t: t0 - elr * (z / 1000), kind: "Environment (ELR)"});
    out.push({z, t: z <= zLCL ? t0 - dalr * (z / 1000)
                              : tLCL - malr * ((z - zLCL) / 1000), kind: "Parcel (DALR/MALR)"});
    if (z <= zLCL) out.push({z, t: td - 1.8 * (z / 1000), kind: "Dew point"});
  }
  return out;
}

card = (label, value, colour) => html`<div class="sim-readout">
  <div class="sim-readout-label">${label}</div>
  <div class="sim-readout-value" style="color:${colour}">${value}</div>
</div>`

html`<div class="sim-readouts">
  ${card("Cloud base altitude (LCL)", `${Math.round(zLCL)} m`, "#38bdf8")}
  ${card("Surface relative humidity", `${rh.toFixed(1)} %`, "#10b981")}
  ${card("Atmospheric stability", stability.text, stability.colour)}
</div>`

Plot.plot({
  height: 340,
  marginLeft: 60,
  // Plot paints its own white ground otherwise, which the dark card fights.
  style: {background: "transparent", color: "#cbd5e1"},
  x: {domain: [-10, 40], label: "Temperature (°C) →", grid: true},
  y: {domain: [0, maxAlt], label: "↑ Altitude (m)", grid: true},
  color: {legend: true,
          domain: ["Parcel (DALR/MALR)", "Environment (ELR)", "Dew point"],
          range: ["#f87171", "#a78bfa", "#38bdf8"]},
  marks: [
    zLCL < maxAlt ? Plot.rect([{}], {x1: -10, x2: 40, y1: zLCL, y2: maxAlt, fill: "#38bdf8", fillOpacity: 0.08}) : null,
    zLCL < maxAlt ? Plot.ruleY([zLCL], {stroke: "#38bdf8", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "4 4"}) : null,
    zLCL < maxAlt ? Plot.text([{z: zLCL}], {x: -8, y: "z", text: [`☁️ LCL (cloud base): ${Math.round(zLCL)} m`],
                                            textAnchor: "start", dy: -8, fill: "#38bdf8"}) : null,
    Plot.line(profiles, {x: "t", y: "z", stroke: "kind", strokeWidth: d => d.kind === "Dew point" ? 2 : 3,
                         strokeDasharray: d => d.kind === "Dew point" ? "3 3" : null})
  ]
})
```

Below the dashed line the parcel cools at the dry rate, 9.8 °C/km, and its dew
point barely falls at all; they meet at the LCL and condensation starts. Above
it the parcel follows the moist rate, 5.5 °C/km, because latent heat is being
released. Whether that warmer-than-dry path stays left or right of the purple
environmental profile is what the stability readout is reporting.
:::

### Simulator 2: 2D Cloud Microphysics & Lifting Sandbox

Switch between **Thermal Convection**, **Mountain Orographic Lift**, and a **Cold Front Wedge**. Watch vapor molecules and aerosol CCN seeds get lifted, cool adiabatically, cross the condensation threshold, and assemble into billowy cloud structures in real time!

```{=html}
<div style="background: var(--md-code-bg-color, #1e293b); border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; margin: 24px 0; color: #f8fafc; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;">
  <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 14px;">
    <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;">
      <button id="btn-mode-conv" onclick="setLiftMode('convection')" style="background: #2563eb; color: white; border: none; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">☀️ Thermal Convection</button>
      <button id="btn-mode-oro" onclick="setLiftMode('orographic')" style="background: #334155; color: white; border: none; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">⛰️ Mountain Orographic</button>
      <button id="btn-mode-front" onclick="setLiftMode('frontal')" style="background: #334155; color: white; border: none; padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600;">❄️ Cold Front Wedge</button>
    </div>
    <div id="lift-caption" style="font-size: 0.85em; color: #94a3b8; font-style: italic;">
      Solar heating creates buoyant plumes that condense at LCL into Cumulus.
    </div>
  </div>

  <canvas id="cloud-micro-canvas" width="760" height="380" style="width: 100%; height: auto; background: #020617; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #1e293b; display: block;"></canvas>

  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.8em; color: #64748b; margin-top: 8px;">
    <span>🔵 Blue dots: Invisible Water Vapor | ⚪ White clusters: Condensed Cloud Droplets</span>
    <span>Dashed line: Lifting Condensation Level (Cloud Base)</span>
  </div>
</div>
```


---

## Summary: The Journey from Molecule to Cloud

1. **Evaporation**: Solar radiation pumps energy into liquid water, turning it into invisible water vapor with latent energy $L_v \approx 2.5\text{ MJ/kg}$.
2. **Lifting & Expansion**: Buoyancy, terrain, or weather fronts force the air parcel upward into lower atmospheric pressure.
3. **Adiabatic Cooling**: Expanding air performs work, cooling at the dry adiabatic lapse rate ($\approx 9.8^\circ\text{C/km}$) until reaching the Lifting Condensation Level (LCL).
4. **Heterogeneous Nucleation**: Water vapor molecules condense onto microscopic aerosol seeds (CCN) once relative humidity exceeds $\approx 100.1\%$.
5. **Macrostructure Assembly**: Trillions of microscopic $20\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ droplets scatter all visible wavelengths equally (Mie scattering), giving clouds their luminous white appearance.

---

```{=html}
<script>
// --- SIMULATOR 2: 2D CLOUD MICROPHYSICS SANDBOX ---
let liftMode = 'convection';
let cloudParticles = [];
let microAnimId = null;

function setLiftMode(mode) {
  liftMode = mode;
  const btnConv = document.getElementById('btn-mode-conv');
  const btnOro = document.getElementById('btn-mode-oro');
  const btnFront = document.getElementById('btn-mode-front');
  const cap = document.getElementById('lift-caption');

  btnConv.style.background = '#334155';
  btnOro.style.background = '#334155';
  btnFront.style.background = '#334155';

  if (mode === 'convection') {
    btnConv.style.background = '#2563eb';
    cap.innerText = 'Thermal Convection: Solar heating drives vertical buoyant thermals into cumulus clouds.';
  } else if (mode === 'orographic') {
    btnOro.style.background = '#059669';
    cap.innerText = 'Mountain Orographic Lift: Wind ascends slope, condenses at ridge, dries on leeward side.';
  } else if (mode === 'frontal') {
    btnFront.style.background = '#8b5cf6';
    cap.innerText = 'Cold Front Wedge: Dense wedge undercuts warm air mass, forcing rapid ascent and storms.';
  }
  initMicroParticles();
}

function initMicroParticles() {
  cloudParticles = [];
  const N = 120;
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    cloudParticles.push(createParticle());
  }
}

function createParticle() {
  if (liftMode === 'convection') {
    return {
      x: 300 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 180,
      y: 350 + Math.random() * 30,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4,
      vy: - (1.2 + Math.random() * 1.5),
      size: 2.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
      condensed: false
    };
  } else if (liftMode === 'orographic') {
    return {
      x: 20 + Math.random() * 200,
      y: 320 + Math.random() * 40,
      vx: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.0,
      vy: 0,
      size: 2.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
      condensed: false
    };
  } else if (liftMode === 'frontal') {
    return {
      x: 360 + Math.random() * 300,
      y: 320 + Math.random() * 40,
      vx: - (1.2 + Math.random() * 1.0),
      vy: 0,
      size: 2.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
      condensed: false
    };
  }
}

function microAnimLoop() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('cloud-micro-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  const lclY = 180; // Cloud condensation altitude line

  // 1. Draw Environment Backdrop
  if (liftMode === 'orographic') {
    // Mountain
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1e293b';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(100, 380);
    ctx.lineTo(380, 140);
    ctx.lineTo(660, 380);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#475569';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('Windward Slope', 180, 320);
    ctx.fillText('Leeward Rain Shadow', 480, 320);

  } else if (liftMode === 'frontal') {
    // Cold Air Wedge
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(0, 380);
    ctx.lineTo(480, 380);
    ctx.lineTo(0, 140);
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3b82f6'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#60a5fa';
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('❄️ Dense Cold Air Wedge', 60, 340);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171';
    ctx.fillText('🔥 Warm Moist Air Overrunning', 460, 200);

  } else if (liftMode === 'convection') {
    // Solar Heating Ground Arrows
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1)';
    ctx.fillRect(200, 340, 360, 40);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fca5a5';
    ctx.font = '12px system-ui';
    ctx.fillText('☀️ Sun-Heated Ground Thermal Source', 270, 365);
  }

  // 2. Draw LCL Cloud Base Line
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.5)';
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, lclY); ctx.lineTo(canvas.width, lclY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#38bdf8';
  ctx.font = '11px system-ui';
  ctx.fillText('☁️ LCL (Condensation Threshold)', 14, lclY - 6);

  // 3. Update and Draw Particles
  cloudParticles.forEach((p, idx) => {
    // Kinematic updates based on mode
    if (liftMode === 'convection') {
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      // Slight expansion above LCL
      if (p.y < lclY) {
        p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
      }
    } else if (liftMode === 'orographic') {
      // Ascend along mountain slope
      if (p.x < 380) {
        const slopeY = 380 - ((p.x - 100) / 280) * 240;
        p.y = Math.min(p.y, slopeY - 10);
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y -= 1.0;
      } else {
        // Descend and evaporate on leeward side
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += 1.2;
      }
    } else if (liftMode === 'frontal') {
      // Forced up over cold front wedge
      if (p.x > 180) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y -= 1.3;
      } else {
        p.x += p.vx * 0.8;
        p.y -= 0.5;
      }
    }

    // Phase transition: Condensed above LCL
    p.condensed = (p.y <= lclY && (liftMode !== 'orographic' || p.x < 440));

    // Draw particle
    ctx.beginPath();
    if (p.condensed) {
      // Cloud droplet (white glow, larger)
      const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.size * 2.2);
      grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(240, 249, 255, 0.6)');
      grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // Invisible vapor molecule / CCN (faint blue)
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.7)';
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // Reset particle if out of bounds
    if (p.y < 40 || p.x < -20 || p.x > canvas.width + 20 || p.y > 400) {
      cloudParticles[idx] = createParticle();
    }
  });

  microAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(microAnimLoop);
}

function startAllCloudVisuals() {
  initMicroParticles();
  if (microAnimId) cancelAnimationFrame(microAnimId);
  microAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(microAnimLoop);
}

// Lifecycle hooks
if (typeof document$ !== 'undefined') {
  document$.subscribe(() => {
    startAllCloudVisuals();
  });
}
window.addEventListener('load', () => {
  startAllCloudVisuals();
});
setTimeout(() => {
  startAllCloudVisuals();
}, 250);
</script>
```
